philippines.title: Tourism activities in Batangas town resume after 2-day suspension
philippines.description:
LUCENA CITY — Outdoor tourism and recreational activities in the Batangas tourist town of Nasugbu have resumed on Tuesday after a two-day suspension due to unfavorable weather conditions, the Municipal Tourism Office (MTO) said. “The suspension on outdoor activities is hereby lifted,” the MTO announced in a Facebook post. The tourism office reminded tourism establishments, tour operators, tour guides, and boat operators to continue observing necessary safety precautions and remain vigilant and updated on official weather advisories. philippines.title: House prosecution panel mulls dropping bribery case vs Sara Duterte
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution panel is considering skipping the bribery case against Vice President Sara Duterte, public prosecutor Rep. Joel Chua said on Wednesday. Instead, the House may proceed with tackling Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth after it finishes its presentation on the vice president’s alleged misuse of P612.5 million in confidential funds, Chua said. “We are considering dropping one article, so for now, pinagaaralan namin kung we will proceed na after next week sa unexplained [wealth], although wala pa talagang final, pero isa yan sa mga kinoconsider namin,” he told the media.
